name: BindModuleLoader
evidence: binds g_moduleLoaderClient to the IOP's service 0x80000006 once, retrying until it is bound, and keeps the service's version word in g_moduleLoaderVersion

name: IsModuleLoaderMismatched
evidence: tells whether g_moduleLoaderVersion, the library's own version (the end of its identification string D_00276970) and the string D_002771D0 points to all differ

name: ForgetModuleLoader
evidence: sets g_moduleLoaderBound back to -1 and clears the version word (LoadIopModules calls it)

name: SendModuleLoadRequest
evidence: sends the module loader a file name of up to 0xFB characters and up to 0xFC bytes of arguments with a command, and returns the reply's size and word

name: LoadIopModuleFile
evidence: sends a module load request (command 0) for a file name and its arguments; LoadIopModules loads each name of g_iopModuleNames with it
